_why_marten9: Marten 8.37.4 ships the DCB API (FetchForWritingByTags, DcbConcurrencyException) WITHOUT mt_dcb_tag_version - the side table the docs call the serialization point, added in 9.4 to fix marten#4591. On 8 a DCB implementation compiles, runs, and can let both writers through, which is the exact failure this folder exists to catch.
_why_wolverine6: MEASURED, not assumed: Wolverine 5.40.1 COMPILES against Marten 9 and then fails at host startup with TypeLoadException 'Could not load type Weasel.Core.IAdvisoryLock' - Wolverine 5 is bound to the older Weasel that shipped with Marten 8. WolverineFx.Marten 6.25.1 depends on Marten 9.22.2, so the whole Wolverine family moves together. A green build was not evidence of compatibility here; only running the host was.
_why_jasperfx2: WolverineFx depends on JasperFx.Events 2.42.2, which requires JasperFx >= 2.42.2; the emitted 1.* fails restore with NU1605.
